channel.title: GOLFRAW
channel.description: Golf news without the press-release language. Evidence first, opinion labeled.

item.title: Hovland Leads the Tour Championship by One Into Sunday | GOLFRAW
item.description: He closed with six putts from 7 feet or longer to lead by one. Scheffler's three back, McIlroy shot 63, and nobody agrees on Sunday's tee times.

item.title: Tour Championship Final Round: Hovland Leads by One | GOLFRAW
item.description: Hovland leads by one at 15 under, Scheffler's three back, McIlroy shot 63. Every number that matters before the final round of the season.

item.title: 2026 Tour Championship Tee Times: Round 4 at East Lake
item.description: Every pairing from 11:55 a.m. to the 2:55 final group, plus TV times, what Hovland's lead is worth, and the rule that could still cost somebody two shots.

item.title: Trump named honorary chairman of the Presidents Cup again
item.description: He's the seventh U.S. president in the role and the second to do it twice. What the job actually involves, and the dates two outlets can't agree on.

item.title: How long do golf tournaments last?
item.description: Four days is the default, not the rule. Three-day tours, no-cut fields, weather Mondays, and the 2028 change that stretches one event to two weeks.

item.title: LIV Golf $300 Million Funding: It Might Be a Loan
item.description: The CEO says an investor signed. Bloomberg says it's a loan. Four vendors are suing. Here's what's actually confirmed, and the September date that decides it.

item.title: Cameron Young's New Putter and the 62 That Followed
item.description: He fell from top 10 in putting to outside the top 100, benched his gamer on a Monday, then gained four strokes on the greens. What you can copy here.

item.title: Hovland in Tie for Lead at Tour Championship: 12 of 14
item.description: He hit 12 of 14 fairways and told reporters he can't explain it. What Hovland's 66 really proves, who's stacked behind him, and the stat nobody checked.

item.title: Tour Championship winners and losers Friday: Scheffler surges
item.description: Two over through four, and Scheffler still shot 67. Who else moved at East Lake, who buried himself, and the number that says this isn't over.

item.title: 2026 Tour Championship prize money payout: $355K last
item.description: Every spot from $10 million down to $355,000, plus the reason two different payout tables are circulating and which one the Tour actually publishes.

item.title: Henrik Stenson PGA Tour Champions debut: the 1-year clock
item.description: He didn't leave LIV. LIV dropped him. Here is the real date his ban ended, where he tees it up this week, and the one thing nobody can confirm yet.

item.title: Good Good Golf Ad Backlash: What's Actually Been Pulled
item.description: Good Good Golf ad backlash: retailers pull merch and Big Break is postponed, but the PGA Tour Good Good Championship is not cancelled. Here is what is confirmed.

item.title: Koepka Joins Detroit's TGL Team. Catch: No Detroit
item.description: Brooks Koepka is Motor City Golf Club's first signing. Here is who owns the team, what it cost him to get here, and why no match happens in Detroit.

item.title: The Tour Championship 2028 Match Play Format, Explained Without the Spin
item.description: The PGA Tour just rebuilt its finale around match play. Here is how the 2028 format actually works, and the flaw Scottie Scheffler pointed at.

item.title: 2026 Tour Championship Purse: The Winner Gets $10 Million
item.description: The 2026 Tour Championship pays $10 million to the winner. But the $100 million FedExCup pool was already handed out. Here is who got paid, and when.
